prompt.en: Use Promise.all to run a() and b() (given) in parallel, then print the sum of the two results.

prompt.vi: Viết async function safeRead(path) trả về nội dung file, hoặc chuỗi "missing" nếu file không tồn tại (bắt lỗi bằng try/catch). In safeRead("/nope.txt").
prompt.en: Write async function safeRead(path) returning the file content, or the string "missing" if the file doesn't exist (catch with try/catch). Print safeRead("/nope.txt").

hint.vi: try { return await fs.promises.readFile(path, "utf8"); } catch { return "missing"; }
